战士们，望着正在做动员的刘济民，每个人的脸上都带着急切。
“咱们不能一股脑地往回跑啊，咱们要是一股脑地跑，咱们一撤。越南人就跟狗似的，闻着味儿就往前扑。一旦乱了阵型，咱们师是要吃大亏的。同志们，大家说对不对？”
“指导员，咱们是不是有新的作战任务？”
“对，你说对了。谁让咱们是主力呢，咱们要承担起掩护兄弟部队后撤的任务。师里将这一光荣的任务交给咱们，同志们，有没有信心完成！”
“有！有！有！”
“好，同志们！D和人民考验我们的时候到了！我们要发扬铁军精神，成功完成最后的任务！全体都有，出发！”
九连的战士按下心中的急躁，扛起装备，开始有条不紊地朝着国境线的方向急行军。抵达第一个设伏区域后，九连跟友邻的部队一起，开始设伏，包括布置雷区等等。
到了阵地上，刘济民一边巡查防线，一边跟战士们谈心聊天。
“小心点，小翠还等你回家！”刘济民拍了拍战士肩膀打趣道。
傍晚，夕阳西下，奇穷河的河面上泛着金色的波澜。禄平县城内，野战医院和后勤都已经走了。县城内时不时听到一些爆炸声，这是在炸一些带不走的物资或者重装备。
夜幕降临，阵地上进入最紧张的防御时刻。一旦高地被敌人攻下，县城内的部队将被敌人包围。
当晚，只有小股部队零散袭击。第二天也还算平静，等到县城里部队全部撤走之后，敌人就疯狂咬了上来。
来袭的敌人主要是越军338师下属的462团一部、461团残部，以及九连此前打过对手戏的独立123团残部、民兵、公安军和特工部队。
这些人在越南第一军区司令谭光忠的指挥下，企图留下127师。
这家伙曾在柳州军校学习，自以为熟知解放军战术，结果被打的鼻青脸肿。
3月9日一早，九连阵地遭到了攻击，在打退进攻后依托工事主动出击，配合周围的部队全歼了这股敌军。
全歼敌方后，九连开始奉命撤退。
“通讯员，向营指和团指汇报，我连已按计划撤退。并随时跟周围连队保持联络，互相配合。”
“是！”

The soldiers looked at Liu Jimin who was doing mobilization, and everyone had eagerness on their faces.
"We can't run back all at once. If we run all at once, we'll retreat as soon as possible. The Vietnamese are like dogs, they pounce forward when they smell something. Once the formation is messed up, our division will suffer heavy losses. Comrades, do you agree?"
"Instructor, do we have a new combat mission?"
"Yes, you are right. We are the main force. We have to shoulder the task of covering the retreat of our brothers. The division has given us this glorious task. Comrades, are you confident that we can complete it!"
"Yes! Yes! Yes!"
"Okay, comrades! The time has come for D and the people to test us! We must carry forward the spirit of the Iron Army and successfully complete the final mission! Everyone, let's go!"
The soldiers of the Ninth Company suppressed their impatience, picked up their equipment, and began to march towards the national border in an orderly manner. After arriving at the first ambush area, the Ninth Company, together with neighboring troops, began to set up an ambush, including laying out minefields.
When he arrived at the position, Liu Jimin inspected the defense line and chatted heart-to-heart with the soldiers.
"Be careful, Xiaocui is still waiting for you to come home!" Liu Jimin patted the soldier on the shoulder and joked.
In the evening, the sun sets, and the Qiqiong River is filled with golden waves. In Luping County, the field hospital and logistics have already left. Explosions were heard from time to time in the county. These were explosions of supplies or heavy equipment that could not be taken away.
As night falls, the position enters the most tense defensive moment. Once the high ground is captured by the enemy, the troops in the county will be surrounded by the enemy.
That night, only small groups of troops made sporadic attacks. The next day was relatively peaceful. After all the troops in the county were withdrawn, the enemy attacked them like crazy.
The incoming enemies are mainly the first part of the 462nd Regiment and the remnants of the 461st Regiment under the 338th Division of the Vietnamese Army, as well as the remnants of the Independent 123rd Regiment, the militia, the public security army and the special forces that the Ninth Company had previously fought against.
These people, under the command of Tan Guangzhong, commander of Vietnam's First Military Region, attempted to retain the 127th Division.
This guy had studied at the Liuzhou Military Academy and thought he knew the tactics of the People's Liberation Army, but he was beaten until his nose was bruised and his face was swollen.
On the morning of March 9, the Ninth Company's position was attacked. After repelling the attack, they took the initiative to attack based on the fortifications and cooperated with the surrounding troops to completely annihilate this enemy force.
After annihilating all the enemies, the Ninth Company began to retreat under orders.
"Correspondent, report to the battalion commander and regimental commander that our company has retreated as planned. We should keep in touch with surrounding companies at all times and cooperate with each other."
"Yes!"
